solves.reasoning: (A) deep concentration → 집중이 맞음. (B) efforts are hard to replicate → replicate가 원문. (C) output reflecting effort → output이 맞음. → ②(A)concentration-(B)replicate-(C)output.
(A) 'pushes your cognitive capabilities' → capabilities가 원문. (B) 'not cognitively demanding' → demanding이 원문. (C) 'routine-type tasks need to be done' → routine-type이 원문. → ①.

(A) shallow work = 'execution' of logical-type tasks, not invention. (B) 'while we are distracted' → distracted가 원문. (C) 'output reflecting our experienced effort' → experienced가 원문. → ③(A)execution-(B)distracted-(C)experienced.
③frequently: 'logical-type tasks that rarely create new value' — 원문은 rarely이므로 frequently는 반대. ①improve, ②replicate, ④stressed는 모두 적절.
②stimulating: deep work는 방해 없는(distraction-free) 환경이 필요. stimulating(자극적)은 반대. ①concentration, ③execution, ④output은 적절.
④concealing: 'we rarely see any output reflecting our experienced effort' — 원문은 reflecting. concealing(숨기는)은 반대 의미. ①perform, ②environment, ③important는 적절.
'These efforts are hard to ____' — 딥워크 결과는 재현하기 어렵다는 맥락. replicate(③=재현하다)가 적합. explain(설명), appreciate(감사), observe(관찰)는 맥락 부적합.
'not cognitively ____' — shallow work는 인지적으로 demanding하지 않다고 원문에서 직접 말함. demanding(④)이 적합. stimulating(자극적), rewarding(보람), exhausting(지침)은 부적합.
'we need a ____ environment' — deep work를 위해 방해 없는 환경이 필요하다는 맥락. distraction-free(①)가 원문 표현. cost-free, technology-free, stress-free는 맥락상 부적합.
replicate = 복제하다, 재현하다. reproduce(①=재현하다)가 동의어. eliminate(제거), exaggerate(과장), simplify(단순화)는 다른 의미.
execution = 수행, 실행. performance(④=수행)가 동의어. avoidance(회피), creation(창조), planning(계획)은 다른 의미.
cognitive = 인지의. mental(②=정신적)이 동의어. physical(신체적), emotional(감정적), social(사회적)은 다른 영역.
shallow = 얕은. 반의어는 deep(③=깊은). narrow(좁은), wide(넓은), flat(평평한)은 반의어 아님.
distracted = 산만한. 반의어는 focused(④=집중된). confused(혼란), bored(지루함), exhausted(지침)은 반의어 아님.
(A) 'other end of the scale' → scale = 범위(척도). (B) 'precise scale to measure weight' → scale = 저울. → (A)범위 (B)저울 = ②.
'ability to direct one's attention toward a task without being diverted' = concentration(①=집중). distraction(산만), relaxation(이완), execution(수행)은 다른 의미.
형용사 demanding을 수식하므로 부사 필요. cognition → cognitively. 'not cognitively demanding'이 원문.
'output ____ing our experienced effort' — output을 수식하는 현재분사. reflect → reflecting.

'Shallow work ____, both because routine-type tasks need to be done and because...' — 역접 뒤에 shallow work도 필요하다는 논리. 'has its place'(②)가 적합. should be eliminated(①), lacks purpose(③), is always harmful(④)은 반대.

'Deep work is when you perform an activity with deep concentration that ____' — deep work의 정의. 'pushes your cognitive capabilities'(③)가 원문 표현. requires no special skills(①), involves simple repetitive(②), produces no meaningful results(④)는 shallow work 설명.
